notes.title: Improvements + Studio update
notes.content:
Some tiny fixes and improvements!

-Minor Adjustments on monsters and day cycles
-Skitter will no longer jump to you in the office
-PVP mode removed, since some players first experience was being PVP Mode and it was not very very fun we decided to focus on other things and remove it from the game.

We will be active and fixing + doing some improvements, the simplest the improvements we can do the better (ex: playing around with monsters difficulty / day night cycle and timings, any feedback here would be appreciated)
[b]
STUDIO UPDATE[/b]

Sorry for the lack of updates, we were working on a new title that you can find here if you are interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623590/The_5th_Door/

This game was a way for us to take a creative break from Dodgy Deliveries, and come up with new and fresh ideas.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: First patch!
notes.content:
Stuff fixed: (Thanks for the feedback we love you so much)

[list]
[*]Now you can move backwards
[*]You no longer see deliverable orders of your teammates (In the past you were able to see where your partners needed to deliver and that led into confusion thinking that you needed to deliver there)
[*]Emotes bugfixes
[*]Now you can move backwards
[*]Softlock when joining game
[*]You now can invite your friends by pressing F in the lobby
[/list]

Stuff pending:
[list]
[*]Sometimes you randomly teleport out of your bike - We still are looking into this
[*]We are working on new monsters! Any suggestion is accepted on the Discord server ( https://discord.gg/HGymKKBPZf ). We love your feedback and we want you to be part of the game
[/list]


On other notes. We achieved 1800 Wishlists for the game and more than 1k people downloaded the game. Thank you so much!

We want to make this game as fun as possible, so please keep playing, recording and sending feedback! We will reward every player that helps us in the current game.


Also. If you are a game publisher, please reach out at info@delivergames.fun !
